data.title: Zámčisko – a poem by Gorazd Petresovicz about the hillfort near Modra
data.excerpt: Gorazd Petresovicz gave our website a poem about the hillfort of Zámčisko near Modra. It tells of the crags of its walls, which Mother Earth keeps for us under a blanket of soil, and of the secret of our forebears guarded beneath it.

children.text: Gorazd Petresovicz has given our website this fine piece of poetry – a poem about the hillfort of Zámčisko (near Modra). Thank you!

blocks.text:
rises above the town,
a lovely wood hanging high,
and in that wood, that little wood,
you too are walking along a little path,

suddenly the crags of its walls greet you,
those remains of Zámčisko,
Mother Earth keeps them for us,
with a blanket of soil she guards the secret of our forebears,

the secret of a nation in the glory of the word
a nation that has had enough of fighting,

our forebears perished here in battle long ago,
here where Love for the forebears will bind their descendants' work in strength once more
without weapons and without fighting
by their labour they will restore its beauty
blocks.title: Zámčisko
blocks.author: Gorazd Petresovicz
